shots.text: Six months. That's how long I've ruled the fire colony.
shots.note: The throne room: Lord Mandros on the root throne above rows of bowing fire soldiers.

shots.text: Thousands of soldiers, and every one of them lowers their head when I pass.
shots.note: He walks between the rows; every head lowers as he passes.

shots.text: They don't call me 250 anymore. They call me Lord Mandros.
shots.note: Close on him in Krell's cracked armor, faint green veins.

shots.text: The green in my veins is brighter now. Some nights it's the only light in the throne room.
shots.note: Night: the room is dark except for the green in his veins.

shots.text: The trap-jaws still dig in the cold tunnels.
shots.note: Blue-gray tunnels, dripping water, chained trap-jaws digging.

shots.text: I tell myself it's to keep them safe. Some days I even believe it.
This morning, a young trap-jaw broke from the line and ran toward me.
shots.note: A tiny trap-jaw breaks from the line and runs at the throne.

shots.text: My guards {impact}grabbed him before he got close.
He looked up at me and said, "My mother says you're my brother."
shots.note: Tavi, tiny, huge eyes, looking up at him.

shots.text: His name was Tavi Ren. I didn't even know he existed.
And then I heard another name, whispered three tunnels down.
shots.note: A whisper, three tunnels away: Kael's outline.

shots.text: Kael Varro. The only friend I ever had.
shots.note: Kael's face, remembered: broken antenna, the scar.

shots.text: I watched him die the night our colony fell.
shots.note: Memory: Kael falling into fire and smoke.
The rebel hideout. Kael, alive, in the dark.
